stories.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
stories.body: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

stories.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
stories.body: CNN, Politico and MS NOW were allowed back into the White House after some of their staff were earlier turned away.

stories.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
stories.body: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.

stories.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
stories.body: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

stories.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
stories.body: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

stories.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
stories.body: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described the measures as "common-sense tools that do not divide but really help to integrate".

stories.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout
stories.body: Proceeds from the tour, which begins in Dublin next month, will go to organisations supporting Palestinians, he says.

stories.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
stories.body: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

stories.title: 105-year-old investigated for crimes at Nazi PoW camp in Germany
stories.body: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.

stories.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
stories.body: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

stories.title: Greek PM urges UK PM to return Elgin Marbles permanently
stories.body: Andy Burnham said in 2023 the sculptures should be returned to Greece with "no strings attached".

stories.title: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
stories.body: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June.

stories.title: Teen rocker Nene Royal becomes first Thai to win America's Got Talent
stories.body: Her heavy metal performance trumped nine other finalists, including magicians and even a robot crew.

stories.title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn Gaza recovery plan
stories.body: The figure was announced during a meeting of the group's board at the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York.

stories.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
stories.body: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

stories.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
stories.body: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

stories.title: Why India's Election Commission is in the eye of a storm - again
stories.body: India's polling monitor is facing yet another crisis of credibility with fresh allegations against its chief.

stories.title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
stories.body: Elisabeth Belien tells Kenneth Law's sentencing hearing she took the poison when she was just 23 years old.

stories.title: Dolly Parton's manager accuses her nephew of 'threats and intimidation'
stories.body: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton's death to the world, is accused of trying to extort her estate.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault
stories.body: Assault survivor Miriam Haley said the "devastating effect on my life and sense of security that may never go away".
